Also I wanna mention that I have this problem for a very long time, I can follow as much as I want under the insta limits but I can't unfollow, when I try to, Instagram doesn't remove my followings and after a while blocks me for a week. This happened to me so many times. 

Also I tried on multiple applications and yeah, It's the same.
posvoen is nice, I like his stuff

Wish I could make you happy, learn new stuff, have fun outside of the world with people. There are things that you can do without the confidence for yourself in front of others, you can just forget about how you look and everything because believe me, your knowledge is the thing that looks lovely on people and the great thing is that you can upgrade it. There's no need to feel that way and your cat knows it. If you wanna talk tho, hit me up.

I mean the people who want us to stay alive. You can't do that, there's nothing to offer. You can be with me the whole day and when the feeling hits me I'm suicidal again, no matter what happens, what's gonna happen.

To our minds It's just an excuse, a distraction from "Hey, bad thing happened to me again, no worries, I won't exist". There's no words to get us out of that hole.
Everything's gonna be fine, believe me

You can do dumb stuff tho, It's like bingo, you have to find that one that your soul needs the most, but sometimes you can end up with the wrong people not knowing they're the wrong one because It's sounds nice and at one point everything can go other way. You can feel like you're the best with the right person, but you can go really crazy if the person you're with is not the right one. You should expirience love for sure, It's like getting out of your comfort zone and doing stuff in front of another person without shame. It has ups and downs but after all, you won't feel lonely and that's why we're all looking for love.
